learning_outcomes.text: Acquire a general understanding of mathematics and natural sciences and develop analytical thinking habits.
Acquire the ability to identify, define, formulate, and solve engineering problems, and to select and apply appropriate analysis and modeling methods for this purpose.
Effectively use current software and hardware.
Learn the general features and usage of the MATLAB Program.
Gain the ability to perform mathematical operations through MATLAB.
Develop general programming skills through MATLAB.

syllabus_topics: General features of the MATLAB program, visual interface, usage, menus, shortcuts, file creation, and structure of the MATLAB editor.
Operator operations and basic mathematical functions.
Vectors and matrices; defining, creating matrices, taking the power, transpose, and inverse of a matrix, calculating rank and determinant.
Mathematical and arithmetic operations on matrices, solving systems of linear equations.
Examples related to programming with MATLAB, conditional statements, and loops.
General information about the Simulink interface and library.
assessment_rules: The assessment method for N.Ö (B) is 50% for the midterm and 50% for the final. The assessment method for N.Ö (A) is 40% for the midterm and 60% for the final. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
